name: patent-disclosure-skill
description: 中国专利.skill：专利点挖掘与交底书（发明/实用/外观）编写，通俗解读专利，嗅探政策动向，辅助审查答复。
one_liner: An AI tool (built for the Chinese patent system) that helps an inventor find the patentable idea in their work and write the formal disclosure document a patent attorney needs.
buyer: An engineer at a Chinese tech company who built something patentable but has no in-house patent attorney to help write it up — or a small patent agency wanting to speed up first drafts.
business_use_cases: An R&D engineer drafts a complete invention disclosure (with diagrams and prior-art search) without needing a patent attorney for the first pass.
A boutique patent agency uses it to produce first drafts for a batch of client inventions faster, then has a human attorney refine them.
A company's IP department tracks policy and prior-art trends automatically instead of paying for a research subscription.

money_ideas.idea: Offer it as a paid setup-and-support service to small patent agencies who want it configured for their workflow.
Sell a done-for-you 'first draft disclosure' service to individual inventors at a flat per-document rate.

steal_this: Partner with one small China-based patent agency, run their next batch of client disclosures through this tool, and split the time savings as a fee — low risk, immediate proof of value.
